server.name: florida-pc
server.instructions:
Florida residential P&C insurance market data (FLOIR QUASR / Quarterly-MIR), quarterly by company (NAIC) x policy type, 2022Q2 onward: policies in force, TIV/exposure, premium, new/cancelled/nonrenewed/takeout flows, claims, lawsuits.
Start with get_catalog (metrics, policy types, periods). Drill down: timeseries -> compare_periods (who drove a change) -> compare_periods with companies=[...] and group_by='policy_type' (what drove it). Use rank for league tables/market share, company_profile for a one-call carrier summary, market_overview for a quarter headline. Results are CSV; $ columns are scaled ($K/$M/$B shown in headers).

operations.name: get_catalog
operations.summary: Everything available: periods, metrics, policy types, groups, syntax, workflow. Call first.
operations.description: Everything available: periods, metric ids/definitions (base + derived), policy type ids, carrier groups, filter/period syntax, caveats and the recommended drill-down workflow. Call first.

operations.summary: Metric(s) over quarters for any slice, optionally split by a dimension
operations.description: Metric(s) over quarters for any slice, optionally split by a dimension. Use to spot trends and the quarter where something changed. Default range: all quarters.

transform.description: value | qoq (% vs prior qtr) | yoy (% vs year ago) | diff (abs QoQ change) | share (% of slice total)

top_n.description: When grouped: keep the N largest series (+ 'All others' and 'Total' rows)

companies.description: Company names or NAIC codes (fuzzy; e.g. ['American Integrity','10064'])

exclude_companies.description: Companies to exclude (e.g. ['Citizens'] for the private market)

line.description: Line of business; omit for both

operations.name: compare_periods
operations.summary: Attribute the change in a metric between two quarters (who/what drove it)
operations.description: Attribute the change in a metric between two quarters: rows sorted by absolute change with % change and share of the net change, plus 'All others' and 'Total'. Answers 'who/what drove it'. Use group_by='policy_type' with companies=[...] to see which lines drove one carrier's change.

operations.name: run_sql
operations.summary: Read-only SQL over the normalized tables (escape hatch)
operations.description: Escape hatch: one read-only Postgres SELECT/WITH over the normalized tables. Prefer the other tools. Main table: facts(period, idx, naic, group_id, pt_id, line, product, wind_only, <metric columns>); also companies, groups, policy_types, periods, metrics. A bad query returns the full schema.
